entries.text: 12% lifesteal for 6s after dealing damage, +12% dmg when HP > 60%. Mandatory per Amya.

entries.text: -40% dmg taken from cav while bracing, +16% dmg vs cav while bracing. Top pick.

entries.text: "Pen will make a huge diff when hitting high-tier units." Top pick.

entries.text: "2x cav DMG reduction at the same time, you already good with 1x." OP's explicit "Don't put."

doctrines.note: No mastery (per Overview). Veterancy: Mix -- 17 top, rest bot. Hero pairing: Heavy. Tips & Tricks: you can reset the Toughness Doctrine (-33% dmg taken on first 8 hits) by swapping the unit at supply and re-taking it; Modao Defense and Modao March both increase piercing defense and slashing defense by 100 for 3 seconds with each hit, stacking up to 15 times. Example build per OP: Epic Bloodthirsty Doctrine (12% lifesteal for 6s after dealing damage, +12% dmg when HP > 60%), Anti-Cavalry Doctrine V (-40% dmg taken from cav while bracing, +16% dmg vs cav while bracing), Unit Damage Doctrine IV (+115 dmg to units, +70 all-type dmg), Toughness Doctrine V (-33% dmg taken on first 8 hits), Defence Doctrine V (+80 def, -5% dmg taken). Edit timestamp (2026-06-27) POST-dates the 2026-06-25 Chaos patch anchor per the guide's own framing -- doctrine/build guidance reflects the current season at capture time (not staleAsOfPatch; Modao Battalion is not on the 13-unit Chaos shortlist, so no forced flag either way).

entries.text: Claymores, Yorkist, and more if a hero jumps you while fighting you.
Rattan pikes, hero dive, block units.
Cav, low dmg units; "this unit is a 'support/tank' unit for blob fight" (per Amya).

steps.text: X-move in, engage with skill 2, instantly press skill 3 right after, then skill 2 again, then brace.
Each time skill 2 comes back off cooldown, press skill 2 and re-brace -- this is for the best burst possible in blob fights.
Don't hesitate to X-move to re-stack your unit.
If cavalry is coming, you NEED to be braced. Brace 1-2s before cav hit.
